methodology.price_source: Yahoo Finance unadjusted daily Close via yfinance
methodology.maturity: Today = prediction-date close; 30D/90D/1Y = latest completed regular close on or before the calendar target date
methodology.direction_tolerance: flat_to_up allows returns >= -1%; flat_to_down allows returns <= +1%; flat allows ±1%
methodology.verdicts: Correct = direction and range right; Partly correct = one right; Wrong = both wrong
methodology.unscored: Matured legacy forecasts missing reference price, explicit range, or canonical direction are excluded from accuracy denominators.
